name: Ripple Surface
description: A framework-free Web Component that lays still water over any content: the pointer is a prow pushing a wake of crests aside, a press spreads rings from where it landed, and at rest it draws nothing and asks for no frames.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A wake behind the pointer and rings from a press, over content that still takes its own clicks.

variants.name: Wake
variants.description: The trail on its own: a point at the pointer, bands of crests either side, and the path it actually took.

variants.name: Drop
variants.description: The rings on their own, from a press, from a tap, and from a page calling drop() itself.

variants.name: Tuning
variants.description: How long a ripple lives, how hard it draws, and how much water may move at once.

variants.name: States
variants.description: The surface over a picture, over selectable words with a working link, and under reduced motion.
